text:
irma: Noticed eu-west-2 tail spikes after midnight. p99 up ~120ms. Node gpunode-303 shows high PCIe TX bursts. Looks like tenant 'viz-batch' sending big streaming uploads.

devon: saw it. PCIe counters + nvtop show DMA bursts every 20s. Could be noisy neighbor.

kai: Can we apply short proxy backpressure for that tenant before moving to dedicated? Less cost.

marc: backpressure idea ok but KV cache still gets trampled. Maybe combine backpressure + temporary placement hint to avoid hot nodes.

noise-bot: alert: pcie_spike gpunode-303 tenant=viz-batch score=0.78

devon: plan: 1) add transient placement-avoid annotation via infra-api, 2) enable proxy throttle (burst window 5s), 3) monitor kvcache_miss and p99. If repeat offender >3x/day -> auto carve to reserved slice.

irma: agree. Keep default action conservative (throttle+hint) to avoid churn.

kai: I'll draft throttling config and cost estimate for carve-outs.

marc: I'll add alert rule to fire if same tenant causes 2 PCIe spikes within 15m.

devon: deploying small sentinel patch now to eu-west-2 non-prod.
